title: Dependency pinned to a placeholder zero version
description: package.json declares a pin to `0.0.0`, the placeholder version package managers publish before a real release. The placeholder usually means an unpublished or local-only artifact, so the dependency resolves differently on any machine without the same local state.
remediation: Publish a real version and pin it, or vendor the code with a recorded hash.
limitation: It matches a pin to `0.0.0`, the placeholder version package managers publish before a real release in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
